headline: The Desk recovery is live through Aug. 22, with exact staging and production verification plus a narrowly repaired claims-ledger promotion boundary.

items.title: The recovered Desk shipped through staging and production
items.insight: Three editions newer than Aug. 11 now resolve on the public site, and every tested article exposes read time, Reader views, and the honest Collecting state while the privacy floor is unmet. The release traversed the guarded staging and production paths instead of treating a Git push as deployment proof.

items.title: The content lane now carries the canonical claim ledger exactly
items.insight: Independent verification found the public claim ledger still frozen at Aug. 11 even though the articles and JSON Feed were current. The promotion gate now permits only api/news-desk-claims.ndjson; arbitrary API and data NDJSON remain blocked, preserving the fail-closed boundary.
items.evidence: content-hotfix self-test 43/43 · content-lane self-test 63/63 · five Aug. 22 claim rows live

items.title: The release was verified at every served boundary
items.insight: The exact candidate passed local and staging browser, mobile, accessibility, and Lighthouse checks. Post-promotion probes bound the served staging head and production content receipt to the expected articles, feed date, claim rows, and Desk presence endpoint rather than inferring success from workflow status.

followUps: Assert the newest edition and its expected rows from api/news-desk-claims.ndjson inside the production post-purge verifier.
Make staging verification derive the newest article and claim date instead of relying on historical fixtures.
blockers: The unrelated full-site identity promotion remains held pending its real-provider passkey ceremony; the scoped Desk content lane is disjoint and promotable.
